as_told.title: Proposed project to clean the shafts with robots, with the University of Ferrara

plain: Filippo Biondi, a scientist who used satellite radar to look beneath the pyramids at Giza, says his team is preparing a proposal to the Egyptian government for what he calls the Khafre research project, a study centred on the second great pyramid. He tells Michels the work would involve his colleagues Armando Mei and Corrado Malanga and the University of Ferrara, and on a later episode he says the plan is to use robots to clear the shafts filled with debris, with the proposal going in "these weeks." If it went ahead, it would test on the ground what his scans say lies under the plateau.
